description: Check which senior-benefit programs a person likely qualifies for, using a deterministic rule engine tied to cited .gov sources — no AI guessing. Requires age plus either zip_code or city + state; every extra field provided turns needs-more-info programs into definite answers. Include marital_status whenever known — many programs' income limits depend on it, so it resolves far more programs than most fields. The result's spoken_summary names the top programs in a few sentences to read aloud. The full guided check at https://discoverseniorbenefits.com/scan covers additional signals.

age.description: Age of the person the check is for.

city.description: City or town name as the person said it (e.g. 'Eastvale'). Use with state when the ZIP code is not known.

has_cognitive_impairment.description: Memory loss, dementia, or a cognitive condition affecting daily judgment.

household_income_annual.description: Approximate annual household income in dollars.

household_income_monthly.description: Approximate monthly household income in dollars, e.g. a Social Security check. Use instead of household_income_annual when the person states a monthly amount; never send both.

marital_status.description: High-leverage: several income limits are set per single vs. couple, so those programs stay needs-more-info until this is provided.

needs_personal_care_assistance.description: Needs regular help with daily activities (bathing, meals, mobility).

state.description: State for the city: 2-letter code or full name (e.g. 'CA').

va_disability_rating.description: VA disability rating (lower bound of the bucket).

veteran_status.description: Whether the person, spouse, or deceased spouse served.

wartime_service.description: 90+ days active duty with at least one day in a VA wartime period.

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (or give city + state).

name: run_eligibility_scan
title: Run a benefits eligibility check
